criteria.distances: Road mile; track mile, 1500m, 3000m and 5000m; road 5K; road 10K; track 10,000m; road half marathon.
include: Fast, flat and accurately measured courses
Competitive, graded or PB-focused races, ideally with pacers
Further afield, only standout fast courses or elite fields
exclude: Fun runs, themed or novelty events

sources.name: Friday Night Under the Lights 5K
sources.notes: Seeded evening 5Ks in Battersea Park. Dates through March 2027 are on the board.
sources.howToCheck: Use event-details.php, not the homepage: it lists dates and OpenTrack RSVP links. data.opentrack.run comp pages often fail to fetch. The 18 Dec 2026 Christmas 5 Miler is 5 miles, outside our distance list, so it is not on the board. Each race's OpenTrack page (e.g. https://data.opentrack.run/en-gb/x/2026/GBR/fnulnov26/) has the current entry standards and the elite-entry email, which is hidden: run scripts/page_emails.py on it. Prefer OpenTrack's standards over the FNUL site's if they differ. OpenTrack pages returned 403 on 13, 14 and 15 Oct 2026, so standards and the elite email could not be re-checked. On 15 Oct the FNUL site still said 'Entry currently open for sub 15:30 men & sub 18:00 women only' for the 27 Nov elite races, and 'RSVP Soon' for NYE. The FNUL site still lists elite entry for the 27 Nov 5K at sub-15:30 men / sub-18:00 women, which differs from the board's sub-14:00 / sub-16:10 figures. The site also lists the 18 Dec Christmas 5 Miler (5 miles, excluded). FNUL announces openings on Instagram first and its website lags behind (it showed 'RSVP coming soon' for NYE after entries had opened), so treat OpenTrack as the truth. All FNUL competitions are listed on the OpenTrack organiser page https://data.opentrack.run/en-gb/o/04a9a6eb-e13b-4629-9da4-1731a595172c/ (NYE 2026 = fnulonpod). OpenTrack usually blocks this job with 403: if you can't load it, never downgrade a race's status (e.g. sold out back to 'announced') based on the FNUL website. 14 Oct 2026: owner confirmed NYE 2026 is sold out, waiting list via ben@bennoadcoaching.com. 16 Oct 2026: the FNUL site still shows elite entry for 27 Nov at sub-15:30 men / sub-18:00 women, which differs from the board's sub-14:00 / sub-16:10. The OpenTrack page returned 403 to scripts/page_emails.py, so the board's figures are still unverified. 20 Oct 2026: the OpenTrack Nov page returned 403 to page_emails.py again. The FNUL site still shows elite entry for 27 Nov at sub-15:30 men / sub-18:00 women, and 'RSVP Sold Out' for NYE, which is consistent with the board's closed status. 21 Oct 2026: the site still shows elite entry for 27 Nov at sub-15:30 men / sub-18:00 women and 'RSVP Sold Out' for NYE. The OpenTrack Nov page returned 403 again, so the board's elite standards are still unverified. 22 Oct 2026: the FNUL site still shows sub-15:30 men / sub-18:00 women for the 27 Nov elite races and 'RSVP Sold Out' for NYE. The OpenTrack Nov page was not re-checked. 23 Oct 2026: the FNUL site still shows sub-15:30 men / sub-18:00 women for the 27 Nov elite races and 'RSVP Sold Out' for NYE, with no email on the site. The OpenTrack Nov page returned 403 again, so the board's sub-14:00 / sub-16:10 elite standards remain unverified and conflict with the site. Flag to owner.

sources.name: British Masters (BMAF)
sources.notes: UK masters championships on track, road and indoors, mile/1500m to 10K only. Open to athletes aged 35 and over.
sources.howToCheck: Restricted by the owner: only fixtures held in the UK (England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland), and only running events from mile/1500m to 10K (track 1500m/mile, 3000m, 5000m, 10,000m; road mile, 5K, 10K). Skip cross-country, throws, multi-events, half marathons, marathons, off-road/mountain, and every overseas championship (World/European Masters, British & Irish international). For indoor meets, list only the 1500m/mile and 3000m. Each fixture links to its OpenTrack page (bmaf.opentrack.run/en-gb/x/<year>/GBR/<code>/), which has entry status and waitlist contacts; addresses there are hidden, so run scripts/page_emails.py on it. Checked 13 Oct 2026: 29 Nov 5K road champs Entries Full, waiting list via the OpenTrack page (https://bmaf.opentrack.run/en-gb/x/2026/GBR/bmaf-5k/; OpenTrack blocks GitHub's servers with 403, but the owner verified on 13 Oct that the waiting list is via ben@bennoadcoaching.com, now set as the race's contactEmail); Cardiff 23 Jan (3000m) and Glasgow 20-21 Feb indoor champs are Advance Notice. Re-checked 15 Oct 2026: 29 Nov 5K still 'Entries Full'. The 24 Oct cross-country relays and the March throws are excluded by the owner's rules. Re-checked 16 Oct 2026: 29 Nov 5K still 'Entries Full', and no other in-scope UK fixtures are listed. 21 Oct 2026: still 'Entries Full'. The fetch did not show the Cardiff or Glasgow indoor fixtures, so they stay on the board from earlier checks. 23 Oct 2026: 29 Nov 5K still 'Entries Full'. The fixtures page now shows Cardiff (23 Jan) and Glasgow (20-21 Feb) as 'Advance Notice', so both stay on the board. The 24 Oct cross-country relays and March throws stay excluded.

Re-checked 13 Oct 2026: elite entries are taken until early December, for men sub-30:30 (10K) or sub-14:30 (5K) and women sub-35:00 or sub-17:00 (5K). Wave 1 is still open. One summary read as men sub-28:30, which was a misreading, so check verbatim wording if a figure looks off. Eventrac still gives no entry status and no sold-out notice, so 'act' stays.
